title: Cloudflare for Startups: credits up to $350k for a year
body: Tiered Cloudflare credits for a year depending on stage and backing. Questions go to startups@cloudflare.com.

title: AWS Activate credits, plus the KSA Founders Club
body: Activate credits for early startups. Saudi founders can also join the KSA Founders Club (up to $10,000 credits, expert access, events).

title: Microsoft for Startups: Azure credits
body: Up to $5,000 in Azure credits self-service, more with an investor referral.

title: NVIDIA Inception: free, equity-free program for AI startups
body: Rolling applications. Benefits include technical resources, discounts and access to NVIDIA's VC network.

title: Modal for Startups: $500 to $25k in compute credits
body: Serverless GPUs and compute credits for early teams.

title: Together AI Startup Accelerator
body: Selection-based: platform credits, engineering help and go-to-market support.

title: ElevenLabs Grants: 12 months of free voice AI credits
body: For startups under 25 people building with voice.

title: Community GPU grants for Hugging Face Spaces
body: Request a free GPU for an open demo from your Space's settings. Good for Arabic model demos.

title: Join the Cohere Labs Open Science community
body: A global research community working on multilingual AI, with projects open to contributors.

title: Google for Startups Accelerator: MENA and Turkey
body: A 10-week equity-free accelerator with cloud credits. The current cohort is closed; register interest for the next one.

title: Claude Community Ambassadors
body: Ambassadors get event funding, API credits and access to Anthropic teams to host Claude community events in their city.

title: Cursor Ambassadors: host a meetup with credits and funding
body: Run meetups, hackathons or workshops in your city with free credits and event funding.

title: Replit Community Ambassadors
body: Credits for members who host Replit events.

title: Vercel Meetup SDK: sponsorship for community meetups
body: Swag, platform credits and a food stipend for meetups of 10+ people, with 3+ weeks' notice.

title: GitHub Campus Experts (for students)
body: Training and support for students who build tech communities at their university.
